# Jonathan Au — Product Strategy & AI

> Personal portfolio of Jonathan Au, featuring his career in product strategy, applied AI/ML, and building exceptional customer experiences.

## About

Jonathan Au has spent two decades turning complex technical problems into products people enjoy. From designing touch-responsive animations for Microsoft's first tablet OS to turning living rooms into multiplayer arcades with nothing but a TV and a few phones, the thread through his career is making sophisticated technology feel simple for customers.

At Amazon, he creates gaming experiences that are fun, engaging, and effortless to dive into, removing the barriers that keep people from playing together. Before that, he owned personalization and engagement for Prime Gaming, shipping recommendation engines and A/B-tested features that measurably moved retention and conversion.

He is currently investing in applied AI/ML, with recent certifications in deep learning, RAG, and generative AI from Stanford, DeepLearning.AI, and AWS.

### Skills

- Product Strategy
- Generative AI
- Machine Learning
- Cross-functional Leadership
- Data-driven Decisions

## Experience

### Amazon
- Role: Cloud Gaming & Personalization
- Description: Creating gaming experiences that are fun, engaging, and effortless to dive into. Previously owned personalization and engagement for Prime Gaming, shipping recommendation engines and A/B-tested features that measurably moved retention and conversion.

### Salesforce
- Role: API Strategy & Integration
- Description: Led API strategy initiatives, helping shape the platform's developer-facing surface and integration capabilities across enterprise products.

### Expedia
- Role: Microservice Modernization & Conversion
- Description: Drove microservice modernization and booking conversion optimization, applying technical depth to improve the traveler experience at scale.

### Hulu
- Role: Living Room Devices & Streaming
- Description: Built and shipped seamless streaming experiences for living room devices, turning TVs into intuitive entertainment hubs.

### Microsoft
- Role: Windows Platform & UX
- Description: Designed touch-responsive animations for Microsoft's first tablet OS. Contributed to the Windows platform, building a broad technical foundation in consumer-facing product engineering.

## Selected Projects

### Two-Tower Video Recommender
- Category: Machine Learning / AI
- URL: https://github.com/jonathanau/two-tower-video-recsys
- Description: A minimalist, research-oriented PyTorch implementation of a two-tower retrieval model for video recommendations. Features sequential user modeling via Transformer encoders, MovieLens genre embeddings, and ANN retrieval using HNSW for fast top-k recommendation.
- Technologies: PyTorch, Transformers, HNSW, MovieLens

### PM Project Brain
- Category: AI Productivity Tools
- URL: https://github.com/jonathanau/pm-project-brain
- Description: An open-source, reusable prompt framework that helps product managers establish a persistent "project brain" for AI coding assistants. Streamlines context loading across tools like Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and Antigravity.
- Technologies: Prompt Engineering, Product Strategy, Developer Setup

### Mobile-Optimized Snake
- Category: Web Application
- URL: https://thesnakegame.onrender.com/
- Description: A fully responsive, touch-friendly modern implementation of the classic Snake game. Engineered specifically for seamless play on mobile devices as well as desktop browsers with an intuitive control scheme.
- Technologies: JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, Mobile UI/UX
